integrity: The transfer identities and inequalities are proved analytically, symbolic checker replayed successfully; all numerical finite checks are supplementary. Independent scientific validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed two-period positive-step standard AB2, scalar real negative mode and SPD matrix extension. No result on changing pair ratios, nonnormal operators, complex stability, nonlinear equations or uniform perturbation bounds. Unexamined historical full text and independent priority check remain risks.
title: A ratio-free CFL frontier and sharp equal-step optimum for periodic Adams–Bashforth two
